m: ग्ना f. (nom. sg. ? ग्नास्, RV. iv, 9, 4) ‘wife’ (=γυνή, √ जन्), a divine female, kind of goddess, RV.; ŚāṅkhŚr. viii
ग्नास् (gen. and nom. of ग्ना in comp.)
ग्नास्—पति m. the husband of a divine wife, RV. ii, 38, 10.
ग्नास्—पत्नी f. a divine wife, iv, 34, 7.
ग्ना—वत् (ग्ना-), mfn. accompanied by divine females, RV. i, 15, 3 and ii, 1, 5 (voc. and nom. [!?] -वस्; ग्नावस् = स्तुति-वाचस्, ‘words of praise’, Sāy.), KātyŚr. ix, 8, 13.
